scope: Estimated calories, local indoor activity recording, manual TCX export and confirmed shift clicks

selfTests.public: PASS: Uetliberg, Gurten, Eiger Bike Challenge 20 km; real-ride energy/recording, private checkpoints, failed-save recovery and TCX export; shared bike physics and custom gearing; terrain filtering and calibrated torque ramp; guided calibration success, cancellation and failure cases (fake trainer); profile migration, validation and persistence; route geometry; BLE packet/state recovery and independent Click slots (offline); demo speed, pause/resume, seeking and finish; sector validation, preview, start, reset and teleport guards; braking, grip and personal records.
selfTests.personal: PASS: Dentenberg, Uetliberg, Gurten, Eiger Bike Challenge 20 km; real-ride energy/recording, private checkpoints, failed-save recovery and TCX export; shared bike physics and custom gearing; terrain filtering and calibrated torque ramp; guided calibration success, cancellation and failure cases (fake trainer); profile migration, validation and persistence; route geometry; BLE packet/state recovery and independent Click slots (offline); demo speed, pause/resume, seeking and finish; sector validation, preview, start, reset and teleport guards; braking, grip and personal records.

limits: Calories use a fixed 24% cycling-efficiency assumption, not a personal metabolic measurement.
Demo/practice, pauses, rejected/missing data and resting metabolism are excluded.
The TCX describes an indoor workout with virtual distance, without GPS or altitude.
Strava may recompute totals; its actual ingestion was not tested.
No new physical Bluetooth recording or trainer-resistance test was performed.
